stem: What is the most likely reason the author uses a cause-and-effect organizational structure in the selection “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening”?
instruction: Use “Public Speaking Is Easier When a Cute Dog Is Listening” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: To explain the results of a program that lets students who need to give speeches practice with an unusual audience

options.label: B

options.label: C
options.text: To explain the challenges that two students experience as they work with dogs
